Signal Sim.title: Signal Sim
Signal Sim.description: An interactive signals and systems simulator for developing control loops.

Pinmux Peripheral Layout.title: Pinmux Peripheral Layout Tool
Pinmux Peripheral Layout.description: A tool to visualize and manage the pin multiplexing of microcontroller peripherals. Primarily designed for WCH and STM microcontrollers.

MCU Select.title: MCU Select Tool
MCU Select.description: A parametric MCU capability search that filters package-specific microcontrollers by normalized peripheral counts before Pinmux routing.
